Ref No: RML/2026-27/723 
Date: October 28, 2026 
To 
BSE Limited 
 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Scrip Code: 543228 
 
Symbol: ROUTE 
Sub: Audio Recording of the Investor(s)/Analyst(s) call 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
This is to inform you that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of earnings call with analysts and investors held 
today i.e., Wednesday, October 28, 2026, on Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the 
quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, has been made available on the website of the 
Company at:    
https://routemobile.com/compliance/2027/Q2Concall-Route-Mobile-Ltd-2027.mp3  
We request you to kindly take the above on record. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Route Mobile Limited 
Tejas Shah 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
ICSI Membership No.: A34829 
Tejas 
Devendra 
Shah
Digitally signed by 
Tejas Devendra Shah
